a2-unit-27.27.1 What does your coffee say about you:
Reporter: What does your coffee say about you?
Reporter: Every day, about two out of three American adults drink coffee. That's more than drink bottled water, according to the National Coffee Association. But your coffee does more than wake you up in the morning. Some people say the type of coffee you order can also show a lot about your personality.
Reporter: In 2014, American psychologist Doctor Ramani Durvasula asked 1,000 coffee lovers about their favorite drinks and about common personality traits like generosity, patience and moodiness. Here's what she found.
Reporter: Black coffee drinkers like a simple life. However, they score low on patience, and they can be both ruder and moodier than latte drinkers. They aren't very relaxed about changes, either.
Reporter: Latte drinkers are the most generous with their time, and they typically want to please other people. But they can feel slightly more anxious than black coffee drinkers, possibly because they try to do too much for others.
Reporter: Perfectionist cappuccino drinkers seem to have the most demanding personalities. They're health-conscious, but some take this too far. People who drink decaf or ask for soy milk are a bit more health-conscious than latte drinkers. They also had high levels of anxiety.
Reporter: Instant coffee drinkers tend to be more relaxed than cappuccino drinkers. However, they aren't very good at planning, and they often leave things until the last minute.
Reporter: Finally, people who prefer cold, sweet coffee drinks had the highest score for creativity. These trendsetters are also a lot more relaxed about their health than cappuccino drinkers!
Reporter: So, is it all true? Not exactly. This was a survey, not a scientific experiment, so don't choose your friends by their coffee order. But it's fun to compare!
